item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russian drone attacks continue, killing 13 people at a Ukrainian railway station and prompting further strikes on transport hubs. A localized cease-fire in the occupied city of Oleshky entered its third day, allowing evacuees to cross into Ukraine via Belarus and reunite with families, while attacks on aid vehicles persist. Russia’s shadow fleet is adapting drones with makeshift armor made from nets and rubber tires. Ukrainian clergy have suffered heavy losses, with 120 members reported killed. The conflict still accounts for 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
Israeli forces are demolishing homes of Palestinians accused of attacks in the West Bank while settler groups are attacking Palestinian olive harvesters, wounding three. In Gaza, Israeli attacks continue, killing at least four Palestinians and endangering children traveling to school. The UN rights office warns that displacement in Gaza is deepening into a nightmare and calls for an urgent UN protection force to be deployed to Palestine. Rare footage of Mohammed Deif and previously unseen videos of Hamas commanders killed by Israel have been released. The conflict has produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Lebanon has charged 13 people for confiscated Hezbollah explosives, reflecting heightened security actions. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon, and Qatar has pledged reconstruction funding for the south. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Sudan accuses Ethiopia of using Assosa Airport as a launch base for RSF drones and of supplying arms to the RSF. Two attacks four days apart in Oromia killed 60 Orthodox Christians. The conflict continues amid the Fano insurgency in Amhara that began in 2023 over security reforms. 2,824 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Uganda began pulling its troops after 20 years and the African Union announced the withdrawal of forces from four bases in Lower Shabelle, while Ethiopia is pulling more than 3,000 troops from Somalia. The UAE carried out its first drone strike against al-Shabaab in nearly a year, and piracy incidents continued with the rescue of seven Pakistani crew members from a hijacked vessel.
